name: argus-cloud
//engines: The one place the Node version is stated. Vercel reads engines.node to pick
the runtime for the deployed functions, and .github/workflows/ci.yml reads
the same field via setup-node's node-version-file. Raising it here raises
24 because that is what Vercel runs and the highest it offers (confirmed
2026-08-21). CI said 20 until then, so every check that had ever passed —
including the next 15 to 16 upgrade — was proven on a runtime production
does not execute. Node 20 also reached end of life in April 2026.
Keep @types/node on the same major. Types describing a newer Node than the
one that runs accept APIs that are not there, and nothing goes red until it

scripts.build: node scripts/embed-migrations.mjs && node scripts/embed-legal.mjs && node scripts/embed-page-dates.mjs && node scripts/embed-image-sizes.mjs && tsc
scripts.typecheck:web: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck:web && npm run build --workspace web && npm test && npm run audit
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace web
